teaser: What does it take to lead when your first instinct is to doubt the plan? Life path 1 asks you to step forward, to be the one who decides and the one who answers for it. INTP asks you to withhold the decision until the model in your head stops contradicting itself. Crossed, this makes a particular kind of leader: one who will not move until the reasoning holds, and then moves with a certainty that looks, from outside, like it arrived overnight. The wait is the work. The certainty is what's left after everything weaker got cut away.
